classes: Rises into place as it comes into view.
Grows into place instead of rising.
On a list or grid: each child arrives a little after the one before it. It rises without fading, so its words are always at full contrast.
A layer that moves a little against the scroll, for depth.
Moves more: a layer that seems closer.
Moves less: a layer that seems further away.
On an SVG: its lines draw themselves as it comes into view. Give each path pathLength="1".
A part of the page that tells a story as people scroll. Its parts use its own timeline.

The scene stays on screen while people scroll through it, and its parts play in order. Only on screens wide and tall enough to hold its words beside its picture; on a phone the picture builds itself as it rises up the screen.
What stays on screen in a pinned scene: the words and the picture.
One part of the picture, which arrives in its turn: first by default, or --2 to --6 for later turns.
How and when it arrives: --fade, --grow, --from-start, --from-end, --draw (an SVG line drawing itself), and its turn, --2 to --6.
states: Nothing moves: the page is still and finished.
A browser without them shows the still, finished page.
tests: scroll effects: still and fully visible for people who ask for less motion, and play as people scroll otherwise
